title: Changes in appliance fuels.
officialText:
Conversion of appliances from solid or liquid fuel to, or the addition of, natural gas shall be
installed per the New York City Fuel Gas Code. Conversion from natural gas to, or the addition of, #2 fuel oil for a heating
appliance shall be made only if:
1. The chimney design meets the requirements of this chapter for the conversion fuel, and the chimney is test run and smoke
tested in accordance with Section 810.
2. The chimney is sized to provide adequate draft and vent the combustion products for the new fuel.
3. The chimney is thoroughly cleaned prior to the conversion to remove collected flue deposits.
SECTION MC 808
REDUCTION OF FLUE SIZE
